Offline addresses, named streets and places

Data: © OpenStreetMap contributors.
License: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL).
Copyright/source notice: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
ODbL: https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/

Runtime extracts are requested separately by the user. No OSM address database
or extract is embedded in this APK/source delivery. Derived databases retain
the ODbL obligations if distributed; the GPL code license does not relicense data.

Default Overpass service: Private.coffee
https://overpass.private.coffee/
Terms dated 10 April 2026 permit application use and require fair resource use,
meaningful project identification, OpenStreetMap credit and appropriate privacy
information. The service sees the selected region and connection metadata.
https://overpass.private.coffee/#privacy-policy

The address index is incomplete OSM coverage, not a guarantee that every address
or place is searchable. Way/relation centers are approximate, not entrances.
